strengths.note: Formal charge is repeatedly identified as Lewis bookkeeping rather than a measured atomic charge, while electron-domain geometry is kept distinct from molecular shape.
The product explicitly warns that traditional sp3d language is course shorthand and not experimental proof of literal d-orbital participation.
Bond order and magnetic behaviour are correctly treated as separate consequences of the same MO occupancy, and hydrogen bonding requires explicit donor/acceptor structure.

findings.learner_impact: The repeated unqualified phrase 'PCl5 geometry' can teach the learner that trigonal-bipyramidal molecular PCl5 is the structure of PCl5 in every physical state. Solid PCl5 has an ionic structure, so the missing phase/model boundary creates a real overgeneralisation.
findings.detail: The title, particle schematic, caption and worked anchor all present trigonal-bipyramidal PCl5 without saying gas-phase/isolated molecular PCl5. The page is already careful about sp3d as shorthand, so the phase-state qualification should be equally explicit.
findings.suggested_fix: Qualify the construction, figure accessibility/caption and worked anchor as gas-phase or isolated molecular PCl5. Add a short boundary note that solid PCl5 is not represented by this trigonal-bipyramidal molecule.

findings.learner_impact: The learner receives rules and diagnostic statements but never sees a complete Lewis-electron inventory/formal-charge construction on an actual species, weakening the Core1A promise to show why the difficult inference works.
findings.detail: The worked anchor asks for the distinction between tetrahedral electron-domain geometry and trigonal-pyramidal molecular shape. It does not carry out the preceding Lewis electron count, structure choice and formal-charge comparison. The MO section similarly discusses occupancy readouts without a concrete filled configuration.
findings.suggested_fix: Add at least one complete species-level worked construction: count valence electrons, build/compare a Lewis structure, compute formal charges, then derive VSEPR shape; and include a concrete MO occupancy example where bond order and pairing are both read from the filled ordering.

findings.learner_impact: The most important model-limit sentence in the PCl5 schematic is smaller than the repository's 13px tablet learner-text floor, making the qualification easier to miss on the target device.
findings.detail: Publication-mode browser replay measures the SVG sentence 'Model limit: static geometry shorthand; not an orbital-composition measurement or mechanism.' at 12.5px.
findings.suggested_fix: Raise the SVG model-limit text to at least the declared learner text floor and recheck portrait/mobile scaling.

findings.learner_impact: Internal duplicate/collision and promotion terminology is shown to learners instead of educational scope boundaries.
findings.detail: The learner page visibly includes 'converted from PR #376', 'BOND-Q01 canonical duplicate' and 'BOND-Q02..Q04 unresolved source collisions' under its learning promise/outside-this-book section.
findings.suggested_fix: Move PR, dedup and custody details to audit metadata. Present only learner-relevant scope and prerequisites in the rendered Concept Book.

overall.summary: The model-boundary language is unusually careful, but the exact render needs a phase-qualified PCl5 treatment and more concrete Lewis/MO construction before it meets Core1A reference depth. Minor learner-surface and figure-text issues should be repaired at the same time.
